name: aura-ui-monorepo
description: Aura UI — design system 3D standalone (shadcn + Magic UI + Aceternity)

scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter aura-ui-core build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-components build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-effects build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-tailwind build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-three build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-cli build && pnpm --filter aura-ui-mcp build
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint apps/docs/src e2e playwright.config.ts packages/mcp/src packages/mcp/tsup.bundle.config.ts
scripts.release: pnpm registry:check && pnpm build:all && changeset publish
